coz.m: Cousin (usually as a term of address).

cozed.m: Past tense of coze. coze: a cosy, friendly talk.

cozeners.m: More than one cozener. cozener: an imposter, a swindler.

cozes.m: A form of coze, as in “she cozes”. coze: a cosy, friendly talk.

cozing.m: The -ing form of coze. coze: a cosy, friendly talk.
